author: you
install_msg: Requires discord.py >= 2.5 (Components V2). Give the bot Manage Roles + Create Instant Invite. Owner-only, DM-only.
name: InvitePerms
short: Owner-only DM invites that grant a chosen role on join.
description: Creates tracked invites via a Components V2 role picker; assigns the mapped role when someone joins through them.
